description: This file defines the MonkeySourceRandom class, which implements the MonkeyEventSource interface to generate random UI events for testing Android applications. It includes methods for generating various input events such as touch, trackball, rotation, key presses, and activity transitions, as well as managing event factors and probabilities.

classes.name: MonkeySourceRandom
classes.description: This class generates randomized input events for stress testing Android apps, based on configurable event factors and probabilities.

methods.name: getKeyName
methods.description: Converts a key code to its string representation.

methods.name: getKeyCode
methods.description: Converts a key name string to its corresponding keycode.

methods.name: adjustEventFactors
methods.description: Normalizes and validates event factor percentages, ensuring they sum up correctly and contain valid key mappings.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates permission mappings and event factors before running.

methods.name: generateActivity
methods.description: Generates and queues a random activity switch event.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next randomized event, generating new events if the queue is empty.
